title: Never allow a NO_PUBLISH decision after an original provider publication side effect
root_cause: Original record_content_publication_skip checked state but not an external provider ID, recorded publication time or provider-created side-effect receipt. Production included an Instagram post previously SKIPPED yet independently read back as a live business account media ID.
impact: Real provider publications may be marked SKIPPED, creating false OVERDUE_PUBLICATION handoffs and risk of duplicate social write; historical analytics remain independently due.
fix: Modify only original publication skip recorder to reject NO_PUBLISH if the original source row or incoming evidence includes an external ID, published_at, live_proven_at or terminal provider side-effect flags. Same service role access, no new sender, scheduler or replay. Preserve exact original provider and tenant lineage.
prevention_rule: SKIPPED is a control decision, not proof of no provider write. If any provider post identity or side effect is present, fail closed to original provider reconciliation, not republish; do not convert skipped items to LIVE_PROVEN without independent provider readback.
evidence: 2026-11-12 independently read back original Instagram business media 17883673467686532, owner 28537384955950341, posted 2026-09-23T10:33:52Z while original source status was SKIPPED
2026-11-12 independently read back original Instagram business media 18060985460558066, owner 28537384955950341, posted 2026-10-02T10:25:23Z while original status was only PUBLISHED
Five original Instagram source rows were repaired with exact provider IDs, permalinks, time and author proof; original 24/48/72h social metric obligations were not falsely closed
outcome: Prevention candidate requiring protected Required/CodeQL and exact source and production readback; past content/social measurement debt remains until verified.
